v.soundcheck.start.text: Sound Check, apprentice. Let's warm up the sounds we know.

v.soundcheck.see.text: Look at the letters on the card. Say the sound they make.

v.soundcheck.hear.text: Listen to the sound. Then write a spelling for it in your Word Book.

v.soundcheck.blend.text: These letters slide together to make a made-up word. Read it out loud.

v.soundcheck.mouth.text: Look at the mouth picture. See where the lips and tongue go, then say it that way.

v.soundcheck.grownup.text: Your grown-up will say this one for you.
